# Writing standard

Before drafting or revising user-facing prose, read [writing-standard.md](./references/writing-standard.md). Apply the section "Plain sentences" before any other section. If a draft fails that section, rewrite it before you show it.

Apply the standard to plans, chat replies, documentation, explanations, and generated markdown. Do not restyle code, identifiers, or project conventions that already make a different choice.

When asked to review text, name the sentence that fails, say which rule it breaks, and revise the text.
